description.value: Akbar's Own is a family-owned Indian restaurant on West Broadway serving generations-old recipes made with fresh local ingredients and traditional cooking methods. Located a short ride from downtown Vancouver near Commercial Drive, it offers a warm sit-down dining room and a full menu spanning curries, tandoori grills, and vegetarian dishes. Catering and online ordering are also available, making it a practical stop for a group or a solo cyclist wanting a substantial meal.
